  • Ter liderado ou desenvolvido projetos com IA generativa e agentes conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em prompt engineering, embeddings, vetores e fine-tuning leve.
  • Experiência com mecanismos de controle de alucinação e segurança em LLMs.

100% Home office;

Auxílio home office;

Vale alimentação e vale refeição no cartão flexível;

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior (inglês fluente)

Experiência Requerida

  • Experiência recomendada: Atuação em desenvolvimento de aplicações de BI.
  • Capacidade de identificar riscos técnicos e de segurança, bem como propor ações de mitigação.
  • Experiência prática com práticas de Gerenciamento de Configuração e Liberação (Configuration & Release Management).
  • Participação em modificações de software durante os testes de integração.
  • Compreensão dos requisitos dos stakeholders e documentação desses requisitos sob orientação.
  • Propor mudanças para melhorar a eficiência e/ou reduzir custos operacionais ou de manutenção.
  • Criar boas práticas e propor melhorias.
  • Levantar requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, incluindo requisitos de segurança da informação, junto aos stakeholders, e documentá-los.

Competências Obrigatórias

  • Experiência comprovada na construção e gerenciamento de workflows de ETL e jobs no Databricks.
  • Forte expertise em Python, SQL e frameworks de processamento distribuído de dados (ex.: Spark).
  • Conhecimento prático em desenvolvimento Python.
  • Base sólida em controle de versão utilizando Git.
  • Conhecimento em pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Experiência com Azure DevOps.
  • Entendimento de Databricks Unity Catalog, clusters e SQL Warehouses.
  • Experiência com Azure Data Factory.
  • Facilidade no uso de ferramentas de linha de comando (CLI) e scripts (ex.: Azure CLI, Databricks CLI).
  • Familiaridade com app registrations e service principals.

Competências Desejáveis

  • Conhecimento dos setores industrial, automotivo ou de logística.
  • Experiência de trabalho com equipes europeias.
  • Experiência com plataformas em nuvem, como Azure Functions e Azure Web Apps.
  • Vivência em integrações de APIs e mensageria baseada em JSON.

Formação Acadêmica

  • Graduação ou Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área correlata.

Idioma:

Imprescindível inglês fluente para atuar com equipes internacionais


CLT - obrigatório

Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: Portfolio Manager (PMO)
description:
Portfolio Manager (PMO)

Empresa confidencial.


Estamos em busca de um Portfolio Manager com forte capacidade de gestão tática e estratégica, capaz monitorar um porfólio de projetos que deve estar metrificado e alinhado com a visão estratégica. Essa pessoa será a mantenedora da governança de métricas e indicadores de um portfólio de projetos de tecnologia, que atendem as áreas de negócio, além de responsável pelo acompanhamento de métricas, de modo que o ato de medir resultados de maneira constante se torne cultura na empresa ao criar visão de ROI para projetos e iniciativas.


Quais serão as suas atribuições?

  • Entender os contextos das diretorias do cliente a partir de entrevistas e imersão nas métricas e dores atuais;
  • Definir e estruturar quais são os processos e metodologias a serem seguidos para monitoramento e controle do portfólio;
  • Mentoria e capacitação das áreas (PMs), com shadowing para testar processo em ambiente real;
  • Adaptar e replicar o playbook do método para todas as áreas, de modo que se torne consistente;
  • Acompanhamento de resultados, orientar/acompanhar ritos das métricas e realizar correções de rota;
  • Possibilidade de ampliação do escopo para um projeto de automatização do processo de acompanhamento existente.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência sólida na gestão de projetos complexos e multifuncionais, conduzindo iniciativas do planejamento à entrega, com foco em previsibilidade, eficiência e valor para o negócio;
  • Vivência consistente na gestão de métricas estratégicas e operacionais de projetos, com foco em performance, previsibilidade e geração de valor;
  • Domínio de metodologias de gestão de projetos preditivas e ágeis, com capacidade de adaptação conforme o contexto e a maturidade do time;
  • Forte capacidade analítica para definição, acompanhamento e interpretação de métricas e indicadores de desempenho.
  • Conhecimento em processos de alocação, planejamento e monitoramento de capacidade, garantindo equilíbrio entre demanda, esforço e entrega;
  • Habilidade para estruturar, analisar e comunicar relatórios financeiros e operacionais de forma clara e orientada à tomada de decisão;
  • Capacidade analítica apurada para suportar decisões rápidas, assertivas e baseadas em dados;
  • Excelente organização e planejamento, assegurando eficiência operacional e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Habilidade para mediação de conflitos, negociação e gestão de expectativas em ambientes multifuncionais;
  • Proatividade, senso de responsabilidade e forte orientação à entrega contínua de valor para o negócio.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir experiência em projetos de implantação de indicadores e métricas;
  • Dominar ferramentas de análise de dados;
  • Tiver trabalhado com gestão de portólio;
  • Tiver trabalhado em um Escritório de Projetos (PMO);
  • Tiver realizado interface direta com executivos C-level.

  • Adaptar e replicar o playbook do método para todas as áreas, de modo que se torne consistente;
  • Acompanhamento de resultados, orientar/acompanhar ritos das métricas e realizar correções de rota;
  • Possibilidade de ampliação do escopo para um projeto de automatização do processo de acompanhamento existente.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência sólida na gestão de projetos complexos e multifuncionais, conduzindo iniciativas do planejamento à entrega, com foco em previsibilidade, eficiência e valor para o negócio;
  • Vivência consistente na gestão de métricas estratégicas e operacionais de projetos, com foco em performance, previsibilidade e geração de valor;
  • Domínio de metodologias de gestão de projetos preditivas e ágeis, com capacidade de adaptação conforme o contexto e a maturidade do time;
  • Forte capacidade analítica para definição, acompanhamento e interpretação de métricas e indicadores de desempenho.
  • Conhecimento em processos de alocação, planejamento e monitoramento de capacidade, garantindo equilíbrio entre demanda, esforço e entrega;
  • Habilidade para estruturar, analisar e comunicar relatórios financeiros e operacionais de forma clara e orientada à tomada de decisão;
  • Capacidade analítica apurada para suportar decisões rápidas, assertivas e baseadas em dados;
  • Excelente organização e planejamento, assegurando eficiência operacional e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Habilidade para mediação de conflitos, negociação e gestão de expectativas em ambientes multifuncionais;
  • Proatividade, senso de responsabilidade e forte orientação à entrega contínua de valor para o negócio.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir experiência em projetos de implantação de indicadores e métricas;
  • Dominar ferramentas de análise de dados;
  • Tiver trabalhado com gestão de portólio;
  • Tiver trabalhado em um Escritório de Projetos (PMO);
  • Tiver realizado interface direta com executivos C-level.

title: Electrical BIM Speiclaist
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U.S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects, including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.

We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:

Eracore is growing in Brazil , and we are excited to welcome new team members. We are building a permanent and professional team to work on Electrical BIM projects for the U.S. market. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.


Why You’ll Enjoy Working at Eracore

• Competitive hourly pay

• Fully remote work

• Learning platforms for professional growth

• Supportive leadership and mentorship


Your Role

  • Perform VDC production work including electrical BIM modeling, coordination support, shop drawings, and spool/prefabrication drawings based on project requirements.
  • Do assigned tasks and deliverables on time and accurately.
  • Ensure meeting design requirements, NEC code compliance expectations, Eracore quality standards, client requirements, and project specifications.
  • Support coordination by identifying clashes, assisting in resolving coordination conflicts, and implementing required updates within the model and drawings.
  • Follow Eracore modeling standards, drawing standards, and project.
  • Provide regular updates on progress, raise questions when scope or design intent is unclear, communicate issues that may impact schedule or quality.
  • Identify missing information or unclear details and communicate clarification needs to senior staff.
  • Actively participate in training and apply feedback from reviews to improve technical performance overall deliverable quality.
  • Work collaboratively with team members to meet project deadlines, support coordination needs.


What We’re Looking For

•2+ years of experience in Electrical BIM

• Experience in modeling of electrical systems

• Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus

• Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection

• Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam

• Team-oriented mindset

• Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused

• Spoken and technical written Intermediate English

About BingX

  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified

  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE


Responsibilities

  • Conduct user audits on the company's risk control platform
  • Monitor for and promptly respond to any abnormal transaction data, making judgments as necessary
  • Continually learn about the platform's rules and enhance personal and professional skills
  • Keep abreast of external competitors' changes in risk control rules and provide suggestions based on current regulations


Requirements

  • At least 1 year of working experience in risk control/transaction monitoring/customer support
  • Possess business sensitivity and awareness of risk
  • Strong psychological quality with effective communication and judgment skills
  • Strong logical thinking and data collection and analysis abilities
  • Strict adherence to professional ethics and information security and confidentiality in daily work
  • Work Schedule: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM (Brazil Time)


Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: Privacy Counsel (Full Time, Remote Position)
description:
About VeraSafe:

VeraSafe is an innovative and successful U.S. headquartered privacy and cybersecurity compliance consulting firm and law firm. Due to rapid growth and increased demand for our international privacy and technology compliance and legal services, VeraSafe is seeking creative, motivated, and collaborative attorneys to join our team, regardless of prior work experience or education background. This is a fully remote position and will remain a fully remote position.


Watch / listen to learn more about VeraSafe: Check out our podcast!

Apple Podcast :

YouTube :

Spotify:


VeraSafe is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work©, with 96% of our employees affirming that we are truly a great place to work . This means we foster trust, collaboration, and a positive work environment. We are committed to maintaining this standard of meaningful work, work-life balance, and a supportive community. Check out our great benefits, listed at the end of this job description.


VeraSafe frequently hires for attorney and consultant positions on a rolling basis. We are growing rapidly and seek to proactively build a strong talent pool to meet sustained, increasing client demand.


About the Role:

This is an excellent opportunity for an attorney with 4-6 years of experience who wants to join a team working on the cutting edge of privacy and data protection, and who wants to further develop a practice in an in-demand, high-tech area of law. We are inundated with business from clients who love the way we advise on privacy compliance (hence the need for you!).


While this role requires professional experience in privacy law , we are prepared to welcome you to our team with a robust and established onboarding and training process. We typically advance people more quickly than your typical law firm, and we do it on an individual basis (no lockstep promotions or compensation).


Note : We include skills assessments in the recruitment for this position. We know this is a burden, but we think it’s worth it, and we appreciate you taking the time to complete it. We’ve found it enables us to find the best attorneys, regardless of their experience, where they went to law school, or where they were trained. We want smart, kind, creative lawyers, plain and simple, and this assessment is a crucial part of our ability to hire this way.


We are not your typical legal job. We use project managers to keep our remote team organized and our projects streamlined and on-track. We encourage our team members to travel and to make use of our ability to work as digital nomads, whether that means spending a few months abroad or on extended trips to be near family. We collaborate closely (you won’t feel like you’re working in isolation) and we actively encourage sharing of credit for work well done, resources, and advice (and penalize the reverse). We are not biglaw. We do top-notch work for interesting clients, yet we pride ourselves on our team members being happy, with time and energy for a life outside of work, which we believe makes us better attorneys who don’t burn out.


The bottom line: If you want to learn or go deeper practicing privacy law, if you want to practice in a problem-solving environment focused on giving excellent and yet actionable advice, if you want to work with a global team of friendly, brilliant people, if you want the flexibility to work in a way that makes sense to you, please apply!


Responsibilities Include:

  • Assessing client information systems for compliance with data protection laws and regulations
  • Drafting data protection agreements, addenda, and amendments
  • Advising clients on privacy-related product improvements
  • Researching legal issues and composing legal opinions/memoranda
  • Writing privacy law related articles and blog posts
  • Assisting in the development of in-house legal templates
  • Contributing to the development of internal procedures and methodologies
  • Collaborating with a team of intellectual peers who value cooperation and community


What We Need From You

Need to Have:

  • License to practice law (active and in good standing) in your jurisdiction
  • Experience in privacy/data protection of 4-6 years or experience in the field of life sciences of at least 4 years
  • Team player, interested in contributing to a growing enterprise
  • Strong writing/editing skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work remotely
  • Willingness to learn new skills and receive direction and feedback from partners
  • Willingness to pursue privacy certifications (e.g., CIPP/E, CIPM)


Nice to Have:

  • Experience working in a law firm
  • Previous contract drafting and negotiation experience
  • Privacy certifications of some kind (e.g., CIPP/E, CIPP/US, specialty from law school, etc.)
  • Professional involvement in the privacy and/or data security space (attendance at privacy conferences; membership or publication in the IAPP, etc.)


Key Competencies:

  • Detail-oriented and highly organized with a strong work ethic
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable using a variety of software applications
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage your own schedule in order to work successfully with international teams and meet deadlines
  • Ability to work independently and fully deliver on all commitments


VeraSafe’s Excellent Benefits Include:

  • Work from almost anywhere with Wi-Fi
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid holidays
  • Annual bonuses
  • Membership in the International Association of Privacy Professionals (IAPP) and IAPP exam fee reimbursement (CIPP/E)
  • Flexible working schedule in some roles
  • Reimbursement for certain personal flight ticket
  • Company laptop provided


Other Benefits:

  • Tremendous professional development growth opportunities in the privacy, data protection, and cybersecurity niche
  • The chance to have a long-lasting effect on a small but growing international business
  • Work in an open environment with a team that respects your ideas and contributions
  • Occasional opportunities to travel in North America and Europe

title: Senior Application Developer
description:
Senior Application Developer – AI Course Bots

100% Remote | Long-Term Contract | EST Working Hours

About the Role

Our client is seeking an experienced Senior Application Developer to help build next-generation AI-powered course bots using generative AI technologies on AWS Cloud .

This role will play a key part in transforming business education through intelligent, interactive, and scalable learning experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop enterprise-grade AI course bots with a focus on scalability, performance, extensibility, and system integration.
  • Implement the technical vision of the course bot platform using appropriate AI models, APIs, and AWS cloud services .
  • Collaborate closely with faculty, product managers, and ed-tech experts to translate educational requirements into technical solutions.
  • Build secure, robust, and scalable cloud-native solutions on AWS for bot deployment and operations.
  • Follow best practices in AI-focused software development , including coding standards, code reviews, and testing methodologies.
  • Integrate cutting-edge generative AI technologies to keep the platform at the forefront of educational innovation.
  • Implement data ingestion, storage, and retrieval pipelines to support AI model workflows.
  • Ensure seamless integration with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and other digital platforms.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and analytics to track bot performance, usage patterns, and learning outcomes.
  • Enforce security, privacy, and compliance standards , including FERPA and educational data protection requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical delivery with business goals and user experience.
  • Stay updated on emerging trends in AI, cloud computing, and educational technology and recommend innovative enhancements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering , or related field.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, primarily with cloud-native applications .
  • Strong experience with serverless architectures, microservices, and event-driven systems .
  • Hands-on experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) , including GraphRAG and contextual retrieval .
  • Experience with generative AI evaluation frameworks .
  • Experience with multi-agent frameworks such as AutoGen, LangGraph , or similar tools.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS services , especially:
  • AI/ML: SageMaker, Bedrock
  • Serverless: Lambda, Step Functions
  • Data: S3, DynamoDB, RDS
  • Strong production-level coding skills in Python and JavaScript / TypeScript .
  • Experience building AI/NLP applications using pre-trained and autoregressive LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, Google, etc.).
  • Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and GraphQL services .
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices , including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and automated testing.
  • Solid understanding of data security, privacy, and compliance in educational environments.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments .

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in educational technology or e-learning platforms .
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Advanced understanding of LLMs and machine learning algorithms .
  • Contributions to open-source projects or academic research .
  • Knowledge of modern front-end frameworks such as React or Vue.js and backend integration.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description


EMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now SaaS products.

We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.

We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.


You Are


An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.

You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and SaaS-oriented design work.


Role Description

This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.

You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing SaaS initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.

Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.

Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.


Responsibilities


  • Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
  • Support video and social content with strong visual design
  • Contribute to UX/UI design for SaaS and internal software products
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
  • Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
  • Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without friction


Qualifications


  • Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
  • Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
  • Attention to detail and strong design judgment
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
  • Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken

title: Engenheiro de Software Sênior PJ (Ruby on Rails)
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.700 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


Modelo de contratação PJ.


O Engenheiro de Software Sênior Backend (Ruby on Rails) será responsável por:

  • Participar ativamente das etapas de desenvolvimento e entrega de funcionalidades;
  • Compreender rapidamente o domínio do projeto e o funcionamento da aplicação;
  • Propor e implementar soluções de forma autônoma, colaborando com o time em decisões técnicas;
  • Garantir a qualidade do código com testes automatizados e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de produto, design e outras áreas técnicas.


Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • Experiência sólida (5+ anos) com Ruby on Rails em produção;
  • Proficiência com ActiveRecord, Sidekiq, RSpec, Devise e outras gems amplamente utilizadas;
  • Domínio de banco de dados relacional (preferencialmente PostgreSQL);
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful;
  • Conhecimento em Docker e versionamento com Git;
  • Capacidade de navegação e evolução em bases de código existentes;
  • Escrita de código limpo, testável e de fácil manutenção.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Hotwire/Turbo;
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD (ex: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI);
  • Familiaridade com integração a serviços externos (ex: Stripe, AWS, SendGrid);
  • Fluência em ambientes ágeis com squads enxutos.

title: Engenheiro de Software Sênior PJ (Ruby on Rails)
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.700 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


Modelo de contratação PJ.


O Engenheiro de Software Sênior Backend (Ruby on Rails) será responsável por:

  • Participar ativamente das etapas de desenvolvimento e entrega de funcionalidades;
  • Compreender rapidamente o domínio do projeto e o funcionamento da aplicação;
  • Propor e implementar soluções de forma autônoma, colaborando com o time em decisões técnicas;
  • Garantir a qualidade do código com testes automatizados e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de produto, design e outras áreas técnicas.


Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • Experiência sólida (5+ anos) com Ruby on Rails em produção;
  • Proficiência com ActiveRecord, Sidekiq, RSpec, Devise e outras gems amplamente utilizadas;
  • Domínio de banco de dados relacional (preferencialmente PostgreSQL);
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful;
  • Conhecimento em Docker e versionamento com Git;
  • Capacidade de navegação e evolução em bases de código existentes;
  • Escrita de código limpo, testável e de fácil manutenção.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Hotwire/Turbo;
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD (ex: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI);
  • Familiaridade com integração a serviços externos (ex: Stripe, AWS, SendGrid);
  • Fluência em ambientes ágeis com squads enxutos.

title: Representante Comercial (RCA) | Hunter Região Centro-Oeste
description:
Sobre a vaga


Mobiis

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (com atuação externa na região)

Região Centro-Oeste



Sobre a vaga


Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.


Missão da função


Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.


Reporte e interfaces


  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno


Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)


  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.


Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial


  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.


Negociação e fechamento


  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.


Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado


  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.


Metas e indicadores (referência)


  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.


Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).


Exclusividade e conflito de interesses


  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.


Modelo de remuneração


  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.


Suporte da Mobiis


  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: Senior Software Developer C#
description:
Software Developer / .net / C# / Microsoft technologies/ ASP / Designer / Software Engineer The Software Developer will work within a Development team, and may be involved in development of new products and maintenance of existing products including the design, installation, testing and maintenance of software systems


Senior Software Developer C#


What you’ll do


Participate in the migration and refactoring of a proxy solution from Golang to .NET, contributing to the evolution of legacy systems into modern architectures.

Design, develop and maintain cloud-native and edge computing solutions within the Restaurant Technology ecosystem.

Apply DevOps practices to cloud and edge deployments, including CI/CD automation.

Collaborate in Agile ceremonies and work closely with globally distributed engineering teams.

Ensure reliability, scalability and performance across both legacy and modern systems.

Understand complex existing systems and contribute to their continuous improvement.

description:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Manager to join our team.   • Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.

title: Full-Stack AI Software Engineer
description:
We are hiring three Full-Stack AI Software Engineers (remote, US-based client) with 4+ years of experience in software and AI agent development.

The team is small, fast-moving, and highly hands-on. Engineers will design, build, deploy, monitor, and support an AI-driven platform. You will work across the stack, from backend services to AI agent tuning to infrastructure automation. Candidates must be comfortable owning features end‑to‑end, working independently, and collaborating with distributed teams.

Our client develops AI agents that automate lead follow-up and customer inquiries, allowing in‑person staff to focus on high‑value interactions. The platform will be white-labeled, so engineers must build scalable, configurable, API‑driven solutions with strong attention to performance, reliability, and edge‑case handling.


Responsibilities:


Senior Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Lead by example—mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Provide architectural direction and ensure technical excellence
  • Drive core business initiatives and scalable AI agent development


Mid‑Level Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Work independently and unblock yourself using AI and other resources
  • Seek guidance when needed—propose solution options, not just problems


Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deliver AI agents and related platform features
  • Integrate platform services with CRMs and third‑party APIs
  • Use AI tools, frameworks, and LLMs to enhance workflows, automate tasks, and optimize customer interactions
  • Build and maintain /Django backend services and scalable REST APIs
  • Conduct hands‑on coding, code reviews, and contribute to system architecture
  • Implement automated QA checks, assist with manual QA when needed, and build scripts/tools to improve testing coverage and reliability
  • Participate in real‑time monitoring and automated load balancing of AI agent infrastructure
  • Diagnose and resolve defects—identify root causes and implement long‑term fixes
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders


Required Experience (Must-Have)

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Minimum 4+ years of Software Engineering Experience
  • Frontend experience should include one of: , Redux, Mui, -query, -table, or Husky
  • Backend experience should include: Python, Django, Postgres, Celery, RabbitMQ
  • CI/CD and infrastructure experience should include: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Gitlab
  • Experienced in performing comprehensive unit testing, collaborating with QA to ensure the team achieves coverage goals, and assisting with automated test development as needed
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG pipelines, model selection, and AI optimization
  • Strong experience building and maintaining REST APIs with robust edge‑case handling and diagnostic logging
  • Proven skill integrating systems via APIs (CRMs strongly preferred)
  • Successful track record in high‑growth lean startup environments
  • Ability to make independent decisions in fast‑changing contexts
  • Experience working in fully remote distributed engineering teams
  • Familiarity with Agile project management and defect tracking tools
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem‑solving abilities


Preferred Experience (desired but not required)

  • Technical or engineering degree (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with white‑label architectures
  • Exposure to AI agent orchestration tools or workflow engines
  • Experience with test automation frameworks


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Banco de Talentos: Consultor de Implementação ITSM
description:
Sobre a Bravo Solutions


A Bravo Solutions é uma empresa inovadora especializada em soluções de software que visam transformar a experiência do cliente. Nossa missão é fornecer ferramentas tecnológicas de ponta que permitam aos nossos clientes otimizar seus processos e alcançar resultados excepcionais.

Estamos buscando perfis para o nosso Banco de Talentos com foco em consultoria técnica. Este profissional será o responsável por dar vida às soluções, atuando tanto na configuração de novos projetos (implementação) quanto no atendimento especializado para garantir a continuidade e evolução das ferramentas nos nossos clientes.


⚠️ Atenção ao Perfil: Esta é uma posição de cunho técnico e operacional . Buscamos profissionais que gostam de configurar sistemas, desenhar fluxos lógicos e resolver problemas de software. Se o seu perfil é focado exclusivamente em Customer Success (CS) comercial, gestão de contas ou métricas de retenção, esta vaga não se adequa às suas atividades diárias.
O que você fará por aqui:

Buscamos um Consultor versátil para atuar em duas frentes principais:

  • Implementação e Projetos: Analisar os processos do cliente e realizar a configuração técnica (parametrização ) das ferramentas Freshworks e similares. Criar fluxos de automação, níveis de serviço (SLAs) e portais de autoatendimento.
  • Consultoria de Suporte: Atendimento especializado de tickets de média e alta complexidade, realizando diagnósticos de causa raiz e ajustes de configuração para garantir o sucesso da solução.
  • Treinamento e Capacitação: Conduzir sessões consultivas para ensinar usuários e administradores a utilizarem as funcionalidades técnicas configuradas.


O que buscamos (Requisitos):
  • Experiência Técnica: Vivência prévia com implementação de sistemas, suporte técnico especializado ou consultoria de software SaaS.

title: Analista de empréstimo
description:
About Monee

At Monee, we believe that every team member is essential to our success — and that diversity of perspectives and experiences is key to driving our business and advancing our purpose of changing the world for the better.

Being part of our team means growing within a fast-paced and agile culture. If you love taking on big responsibilities and doing what has never been done before, Monee is the place for you.

Here, you’ll face meaningful challenges, collaborate with a diverse team, and help shape the future of the fintech industry in Brazil — creating a positive impact in the lives of millions.

Work Model

We adopt a hybrid work model, this model allows people to adjust their work environment according to their personal needs, while promoting collaboration and interaction in the office.



What will be your mission?

Planning and execution of projects related to credit products, including participation in and development of initiatives focused on identifying business opportunities, conducting in-depth analyses, and implementing new solutions. Creation of strategic initiatives aimed at driving growth and cost reduction. Leadership of workstreams within high-impact projects in a fast-paced environment, ensuring concrete and tangible deliverables. Ongoing interaction with teams across different areas and countries, as well as direct collaboration with multiple internal stakeholders and external partners.


What will your day-to-day be like?

  • Build and launch new credit products (with focus on consumer) while monitoring the results of current product portfolio;
  • Identify business opportunities, conduct in-depth analysis, and implement new solutions;
  • Prepare and present business cases to both local and international audiences
  • Own and deliver strategic and tactical initiatives to drive growth and cost reduction;
  • Lead workstreams in high-impact projects in a fast-paced environment, with concrete and tangible deliverables;
  • Interact with teams from different areas and countries. Work closely with the SG SeaMoney team.
  • High exposure to top management.



What you need to take on the challenge:

  • Experience in Credit Products for Consumers (BNPL, Personal Loan, Secured Credit etc.)
  • Advanced English (speaking, reading, and writing is mandatory);
  • Hands-on profile, ability to think strategically;
  • Data-drive profile, being capable of dealing with complex models and analysis;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with cross-functional teams and external

stakeholders;

  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Benefits:
  • Medical and dental care, extended to dependents;
  • Partnership with Gympass and TotalPass;
  • Flexible meal/food vouchers;
  • Transportation vouchers, mobility vouchers or on-site parking;
  • Flexible benefits;
  • Zenklub;
  • Discretionary annual bonus, linked to performance.

COME MAKE HISTORY WITH US.

WHAT MAKES YOU UNIQUE, MAKES US BETTER!

title: Fullstack Developer (Node.js + React + AWS)
description:
About You

You are a hands-on senior engineer who enjoys owning complex systems end-to-end. You are passionate about building scalable, production-grade applications in the cloud and want to contribute to architectural decisions while mentoring others and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a remote-first environment.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or Software Engineering.
  • 7+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Proven experience building full-stack applications using React and TypeScript . Experience with modern React state management patterns.
  • Solid experience designing and operating REST and/or GraphQL APIs .
  • Hands-on experience with AWS serverless services such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and S3.
  • Strong knowledge of event-driven architectures in production environments.
  • Strong experience with DynamoDB in production environments, including single-table design, partition/sort key strategies, TTL, and cost-efficient scaling.
  • Experience supporting hybrid architectures , including coexistence with legacy SQL-based systems.
  • Hands-on experience provisioning infrastructure using AWS CDK or other IaC tools (CloudFormation, Terraform)
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (preferably GitHub Actions).
  • Solid understanding of logging, monitoring, and observability using CloudWatch or similar tools.
  • Strong frontend skills with state management patterns such as React Query, Redux, or Zustand.
  • Advanced English proficiency and ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Develop and operate high-performance REST and GraphQL APIs.
  • Implement and evolve event-driven architectures using AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, SNS, and API Gateway.
  • Model and optimize data access patterns in DynamoDB, ensuring performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Support system evolution by enabling hybrid architectures during migrations from legacy platforms to serverless solutions.
  • Provision and manage infrastructure using AWS CDK and cloud-native best practices.
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines covering linting, testing, building, deployments, and environment management.
  • Ensure production readiness through proper logging, monitoring, alerting, and observability.
  • Build and maintain frontend applications using React and TypeScript, applying clean component architecture and performance optimizations.
  • Collaborate closely with product, backend, and frontend teams to deliver cohesive full-stack solutions.
  • Participate in architectural discussions, perform code reviews, and promote best engineering practices.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience building full-stack apps with React, Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience with AWS serverless : Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB.
  • Experience designing and operating REST APIs (GraphQL is a plus).
  • Experience working with event-driven architectures in production environments.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Technical Customer Support Representative (L1)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Technical Customer Support (TCS) Representative with 2+ years of Level 1 support experience, preferably in a doctor's office, veterinary clinic, hospital, or similar healthcare environment. You will use your critical thinking skills to listen to and understand customer needs, offering timely solutions that drive value and customer satisfaction. You will be involved in all aspects of support, including product demonstrations and customer education.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Perform core functions of technical support, configuration tasks, and scheduling
  • Maintain high reliability in terms of on-time attendance and availability in assigned channels per shift schedule
  • Provide a timely response and resolution to all inbound customer support (phone, chats, and emails) to understand customer needs and feedback
  • Demonstrate understanding of the client's core products and everyday use cases within the veterinary industry, engaging with customers effectively on their issues
  • Identify the root cause of customer issues, understand the steps to replicate and solve the problem within the client's means, and escalate when not
  • Stay updated on product knowledge to help build and curate knowledge articles
  • Deliver excellent customer experience to clinics and pet owners
  • Ensure root cause and solution are provided consistently
  • Provide all-channel support during designated shift hours:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 AM - 4 PM CT (preferred) or 9 AM - 6 PM CT
  • Provide live channel (phone, chat) support during periodic flex times (1 to 2 times per month):
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 - 8 AM CT or 5 - 6 PM CT
  • Fridays
  • 1 - 2 PM CT or 3 - 4 PM CT


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2+ years of Level 1 support for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) product
  • Experience with Zendesk Talk, Messaging, and Support or similar platforms
  • Great attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting clinician environments, including veterinarian clinics, doctor offices, or hospitals


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Analista de desenvolvimento de software SR
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

O dia a dia:

  • Disseminar conhecimento e documentar decisões técnicas, por meio da criação de documentos ou registros no sistema de gestão.
  • Promover boas práticas de desenvolvimento, qualidade de código e testes automatizados, por meio de capacitações, compartilhamento de informações e registros.
  • Identificar e remover bloqueios que impactem as entregas do time.
  • Realizar revisão de código e de decisões técnicas, garantindo estabilidade, qualidade e aderência aos padrões da empresa.
  • Contribuir com os Coordenadores de Produto na definição de roadmap e na estratégia do time, considerando aspectos técnicos.
  • Apoiar outros times de Engenharia, garantindo que grandes lançamentos e mudanças tecnológicas ocorram de forma segura, minimizando impactos.
  • Participar da definição de projetos e tarefas, avaliando arquitetura, impactos, estratégias de deploy e entregáveis.
  • Desenvolver pipelines de Integração Contínua (CI).
  • Estruturar monitoramento, alarmes e ferramentas de troubleshooting.
  • Avaliar trade-offs, riscos e impactos para subsidiar decisões técnicas.
  • Desdobrar projetos complexos em entregas menores, executáveis por si ou pelo time.
  • Trazer visibilidade sobre débitos técnicos e riscos, propondo priorizações para mitigação.
  • Investigar e atuar em incidentes de produção, liderando a análise e correção da causa raiz.
  • Antecipar impactos de mudanças e novos produtos na arquitetura existente, propondo ações de mitigação.
  • Definir, discutir e documentar padrões de código, práticas de qualidade e estratégias de testes.
  • Identificar e mitigar riscos de segurança nos sistemas.
  • Apoiar a liderança imediata na análise de problemas e definição de ações, contribuindo para a melhoria dos processos.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de normas e procedimentos da área, identificando e sugerindo melhorias.
  • Analisar processos e propor melhorias que contribuam para a eficiência e os resultados da área.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências e inovações tecnológicas, promovendo a melhoria contínua.
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas, conforme orientação da liderança.


Requisitos e qualificações

Para essa posição, esperamos que você tenha:

  • Experiência prática com Datadog para monitoramento de aplicações, análise de logs e construção de dashboards.
  • Conhecimento em OpenTelemetry para instrumentação de serviços e geração de métricas, traces e logs.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de observabilidade em ambientes distribuídos, como definição de SLOs, criação de alertas, análise de causa raiz e correlação de eventos.
  • Vivência com arquitetura baseada em microsserviços, uso de mensageria (como Kafka ou RabbitMQ) e integração com sistemas legados ou de terceiros.
  • Capacidade de desenhar soluções escaláveis, resilientes e observáveis.
  • Experiência sólida com TypeScript e Node.js no desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços backend.
  • Proficiência no uso do framework NestJS, incluindo conceitos como injeção de dependência, interceptors, pipes, guards e modules.
  • Experiência na criação e manutenção de APIs REST, seguindo boas práticas de versionamento, documentação e segurança.


Informações adicionais

title: Mobile Developer (iOS)
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to design, build, and ship high-quality mobile applications, with a strong focus on iOS-first development . This role is ideal for someone who has spent years building production iOS apps, thrives in early-stage or fast-moving environments , and enjoys owning features end to end—from architecture decisions to App Store delivery.


You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver scalable, high-performance mobile experiences while maintaining clean, testable, and well-structured code.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain advanced iOS applications , with Android considered a plus.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements, design solutions, and ship new features.
  • Own performance, quality, and responsiveness across the mobile app.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, crashes, and complex bugs.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code, contributing to automation and CI/CD workflows.
  • Integrate mobile applications with RESTful or GraphQL APIs and third-party libraries.
  • Make informed architectural decisions suitable for scalable MVPs and growing products .
  • Stay current with iOS best practices, platform updates, and modern mobile development trends.
  • Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies , including planning, reviews, and technical discussions.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of professional experience in mobile development, with a strong focus on iOS.
  • Proven track record of shipping at least one high-quality iOS app to the App Store .
  • Deep proficiency in Swift and SwiftUI (or UIKit, depending on project needs).
  • Solid understanding of the full mobile application development lifecycle , from concept to release and iteration.
  • Strong knowledge of mobile UI/UX patterns and Apple platform guidelines.
  • Hands-on experience integrating mobile apps with RESTful or GraphQL APIs .
  • Proficiency with Git , Xcode , and modern dependency managers such as Swift Package Manager .
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership mindset.
  • Advanced written and spoken English for collaboration in a distributed, international team.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with UIKit , Combine , Async/Await , CoreData , or Realm .
  • Experience implementing or customizing video playback features using AVPlayer / AVKit (or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with Android development (Kotlin/Java) is a plus.
  • Experience setting up or working with CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
  • Experience using mobile performance and profiling tools (Instruments, Crashlytics, etc.).
  • Background working in early-stage startups or building MVPs from scratch.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


Responsabilidades:

Experiência atuando com ferramentas Microsoft, com foco em Cloud Azure.

Experiência em computação em nuvem, especialmente com Databricks e Azure Data Factory. Habilidade para manipular e extrair insights de grandes conjuntos de dados.

Suporte, manutenção e criação de pipelines/ETLs.

Prompt AI, Power BI e Airflow .

Desenvolver, otimizar e gerenciar pipelines de dados e ETLs.

Implementar mecanismos de segurança para acesso aos dados.

Monitorar a execução dos sistemas e das pipelines.

Elaborar soluções de dados completas para os clientes.

CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Senior Software (TypeScript/Ruby/React) Engineer
description:
Summary

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help shape and scale a modern web experience for a fast-paced, consumer-facing product team. You’ll work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver elegant, performant, and maintainable applications using TypeScript, Ruby on Rails and React . This role is ideal for someone who possesses a high level of agency, a \"doer\" mentality, and the ability to maintain a full product vision while shipping high-quality code at speed.


Core Requirements :

  • Mastery of TypeScript and React for building complex, scalable web applications.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in frontend development with a proven track record of shipping production-grade software.
  • Experience working with Ruby on Rails (or interest in a product where RoR is core)
  • Prior experience in the Trading, Brokerage, or Wealth Management industries.
  • Demonstrated high level of agency and a proactive \"doer\" mentality, with the ability to hit the ground running and own features end-to-end.
  • Strong product sense and the ability to build for the long term while balancing immediate delivery needs.
  • Excellent understanding of modern frontend architecture, state management, and performance optimization.
  • Solid experience with unit testing and a commitment to maintaining high code quality through thoughtful testing practices.
  • Comfort navigating fast-paced environments and collaborating within cross-functional agile teams.
  • Strong eye for design-to-dev fidelity and a passion for creating fluid, responsive user interfaces.


Nice to Have :

  • Full-stack development experience or a strong understanding of backend systems and API design.
  • Experience working with GraphQL APIs and modern data-fetching libraries.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows for web applications.
  • Exposure to modern CSS-in-JS libraries or advanced styling frameworks.


Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community, fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career - we’re the destination.


The icing on the Kake:

Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.

Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.

Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.

❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

title: Application Support- Dynatrace (Realocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What will you be doing:

  • Providing application support and monitoring using Dynatrace;
  • Troubleshooting and resolving issues in Linux-based environments;
  • Ensuring observability and performance optimization of applications;
  • Collaborating with development and infrastructure teams to enhance system reliability;
  • Writing and executing SQL queries for data analysis and issue resolution;
  • Establishing best practices for application performance and monitoring;



What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or similar;
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Application Support, with at least 3 years of Dynatrace experience;
  • Experience with Linux environments;
  • SQL knowledge (other database experience is also considered);
  • Experience in Observability/Monitoring tools (Dynatrace preferred);
  • Java knowledge is a plus;
  • Minimum B2 level in English (written and spoken), and Portuguese ;
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills;
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and collaborate with cross-functional teams;
  • Hybrid work model: available to work in Porto or Lisbon;
  • Mandatory availability to relocate (from Brazil to Portuga l).



What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid setting based in Lisbon or Porto.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.

title: Python/Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Python/Cloud Platform Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.

Essential Skills


  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.
